mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipts ( user_id, trip_id, country_id, currency_id, payment_datetime, file_name, file_url, file_type, status, merchant_original_name, merchant_translated_name, total_amount, tax_amount, ocr_raw_text, split_count, error_message, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{countryId}, #{currencyId}, #{paymentDateTime}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileType}, #{status}, #{merchantOriginalName}, #{merchantTranslatedName}, #{totalAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{ocrRawText}, #{splitCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{processedAt} )

INSERT INTO receipt_items ( receipt_id, original_name, translated_name, quantity, amount, display_order ) VALUES
( #{item.receiptId}, #{item.originalName}, #{item.translatedName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.amount}, #{item.displayOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.trip_id, r.merchant_original_name, r.merchant_translated_name, r.payment_datetime, c.currency_code, c.symbol AS currency_symbol, r.total_amount, r.split_count, r.file_url FROM receipts r LEFT JOIN currencies c ON c.id = r.currency_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.payment_datetime DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.trip_id, r.country_id, country.country_name, r.currency_id, currency.currency_code, currency.currency_name, currency.symbol AS currency_symbol, r.payment_datetime, r.file_name, r.file_url, r.file_type, r.status, r.merchant_original_name, r.merchant_translated_name, r.total_amount, r.tax_amount, r.split_count, r.ocr_raw_text, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM receipts r LEFT JOIN countries country ON country.id = r.country_id LEFT JOIN currencies currency ON currency.id = r.currency_id WHERE r.id = #{receiptId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT item.id, item.receipt_id, item.original_name, item.translated_name, item.quantity, item.amount, item.display_order, item.is_deleted, item.deleted_at, item.created_at, item.updated_at FROM receipt_items item INNER JOIN receipts receipt ON receipt.id = item.receipt_id WHERE item.receipt_id = #{receiptId} AND receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.is_deleted = 0 AND item.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY item.display_order ASC, item.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE receipts SET trip_id = #{tripId}, country_id = #{countryId}, currency_id = #{currencyId}, payment_datetime = #{paymentDateTime}, merchant_original_name = #{merchantOriginalName}, merchant_translated_name = #{merchantTranslatedName}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, tax_amount = #{taxAmount}, ocr_raw_text = #{ocrRawText}, split_count = #{splitCount} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE receipt_items item INNER JOIN receipts receipt ON receipt.id = item.receipt_id SET item.is_deleted = 1, item.deleted_at = NOW() WHERE item.receipt_id = #{receiptId} AND receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.is_deleted = 0 AND item.is_deleted = 0
